answer: Sybils splitting into many fake identities must post the same bond per identity, so forging N agents costs N times the stake plus forfeited bonds when peers detect duplicate pulses. Each agent must stake a sable bond locked to a unique grove identity, and every epoch it submits a signed pulse proving liveness. Honest agents pay once and recover their bond, making mass identity creation economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0246's threat model.
